description: This Java class defines the response to a CreatePolicy command within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing policy details, and serialization.

classes.name: CreatePolicyResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a CreatePolicy command, including JSON serialization/deserialization, accessors for policy data, and response metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CreatePolicyResponse instance with specified policy ID, policy, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CreatePolicyResponse instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicyCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Policy, if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the Policy as a JsonValue, if available, for a given schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for this resource, which is empty.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the policy ID and policy data to a JSON object builder, based on schema and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new CreatePolicyResponse with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of CreatePolicyResponse for equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on policy ID and created policy.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
